mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as accommodative monetary policy supports valuation expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth prospects decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline exceeding 0.25pp and unemployment rate rise exceeding 0.2pp signals recessionary monetary policy response, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic contraction risks dominate.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 0.25pp and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) in regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change above 3.5%) prompt aggressive central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract under rising discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of high inflation regime instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO above 101.0) indicates strengthening manufacturing output and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 101.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 900 thousand units signal weak consumer demand for housing and broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 900, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction and economic slowdown, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Growing payrolls (PAYEMS above 137,000) signal robust labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic expansion momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 137,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
